address: 202 Hoang Dieu Street, Nam Duong Ward, Hai Chau District, Da Nang, 50000, Vietnam
bio: For over 10 years, Ngọc Chi has been serving an extensive menu of mostly Vietnamese origin using local veggies and herbs. Some dishes include plant-based meat. Fermented seasonings are put to good use, accentuating big-boned flavours while supporting a healthy lifestyle. Whet your appetite with a bowl of sour soup featuring mixed veggies. Then move on to wontons and spring rolls, hand-wrapped and deep-fried to perfection á la minute....
